question: When a part is joined to a ring of knots under the cheapest parity growth, does the product law (return equation y^n (1+y)^j prod F_k(y) = 1, F_s = 1 + y(1+y)^s, renewing offshoot 1/(1-y)) predict the growth exactly on fresh starts; do joins always speed the ring; how do two joined rings grow; do joins without a ring stay polynomial?

definitions.bare start: each knot max(3, shared + round-1 demand) places plus listed surplus distinctions
definitions.holds: the predicted annihilator annihilates the grown counts from some round t0 <= 12 with at least three rounds tested past its order

public_inputs.code: fastlib.py (sha256 984252a28a9c4448d922119d1c7ba6f1bbfc4eb714c801fa12d3d864e348161d), joinlib.py (sha256 007e597cc3157c29d5768eafc0a704fd2aa8235cb1768da69dd0062001dd7588), reclib.py (sha256 e0b2fae70f9baf5aff98e0a96093fc5b1b9aeeb6103ff6a63cdbef7027dcdf01), job.py (sha256 ad0bcd826e172f189cc2d1e2a146df56e1523e974ea3741576a9a5e23b9058a0), merge.py (sha256 fae25419407abd77a785efb5167765206cabb1872d71df09b470518fa09597f4), checks.py (sha256 c7962e51c4c2f05f35282f6fde5ec77f0c2a08fef8a3539814adde8ecc8f6c82)
public_inputs.run: scripts/longrun.py launch job.py (7 workers, 2G per case, 900 s per case); .venv/bin/python -B merge.py <out dir> <results.json>
public_inputs.reused: FIRST-KNOT-20261118-001B startlib.py and FRESH-COUNT-20261118-001B freelib.py (the policy); TOUCH-CENSUS-20261118-001B arrlib.py (gate starts)

forbidden_inputs: Changing a case, a predicted annihilator or a decision rule after reading any census result
cheapest_meaningful_control: family E (joins without a ring) and the gate's clean rings

predictions.P2: products at separate knots, any positions (A2)
predictions.P3: two lone adjuncts on one knot multiply (A3)
predictions.P5: two-fold piece with surplus: F_sA F_sB (A5)
predictions.P6: ring surplus beside the piece adds (1+y) (A6)
predictions.P7: product law on every D/K join of the census D (48; 35 unseen)
predictions.P8: every join of families A, B, D faster than its ring alone
predictions.P9: two rings: no recurrence of order <= 7; lambda > 1.5; lambda decreasing in ring length; alpha in [-2, -1]
predictions.P10: no ring: never exponential, dimension at most 2

stop_rule: One run; read-out; referee hand-off; report.
disclosed_exploration: pilot/ (about 40 starts, fitting); 14 starts of family D repeat pilot starts (merge.py SEEN)
